tools.name: scan_url
tools.description: Fetches a public web page and scans its visible text plus hidden HTML (comments, hidden elements, alt/aria/meta text) for prompt injection, before your agent browses or summarizes it. Use scan_text if you already have the content and scan_tools for MCP tool definitions. Respects robots.txt and refus
